{{Top|leg}}
'''High-tension cable''' was used by [[power harpoon launcher]]s to tow cargo modules and [[Skiff/Legends|skiffs]] behind [[Spacetug/Legends|tugs]] and [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> Made of [[flexisteel]],<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Power Harpoon}}</ref> the cable was attached to [[fusion disk]]s that attached to a target's surface, allowing it to be towed. Each spool of cable was two hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long.<ref name="EGWT" />
